test_empty_meshes: test mesh edge loss computation on a batch of empty meshes with no faces
test_mesh_edge_loss_naive: test the naive iterative mesh edge loss implementation against a target edge length
test_mesh_edge_loss_output: test that the tensorized mesh edge loss matches the naive iterative implementation output
run_mesh_edge_loss_benchmark: run a benchmark of mesh edge loss computation on randomly initialized meshes with configurable size
review_mesh_edge_loss: review the mesh edge loss test suite covering empty meshes, output correctness, and benchmarking
